newsitem.title: USA: MBIA has capacity for N.C. Eastern Municipal Power.
newsitem.headline: MBIA has capacity for N.C. Eastern Municipal Power.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp said Friday it has a limited supply of secondary market insurance capacity for North Carolina Eastern Municipal Power Agency power system revenue bonds.
Capacity was limited to $10 million per firm Friday, and was available on a first-come, first-served basis, MBIA said.
Derivatives and floating-rate bonds of the issuer were not eligible, MBIA said.
